**1. Issues that > 9 % of California adults (any region) flagged as most important in the 2018 PPIC statewide survey**

| Issue | % of adults who said it was the “most important problem” (overall) |
|-------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Immigration** | 15 % |
